title: Servants' Way
description: In the dark below, you find a narrow ladder dropping straight down into the manor's depths - above you, the broken floor of the Entry Hall still creaking. The rungs are iron and cold, slick with a damp that has never been touched by light. A draft rising from below carries iron, old straw, and a stillness that sits inside the chest. Checking the surroundings, you are pretty sure that you'd be able to get back, but the ladder seems the most obvious way forward - you have no clue where it will lead though. As expendables Vessels are, you need to be realistic about your odds of success.

destinations.label: Keep descending towards the humid cold and the darkness below.
Climb back into the entry hall and keep exploring.

visual.alt_text: A narrow ladder drops down into the shadows below.
